title: Solid Core vs. Cellular Core PVC Pipe
description: PVC DWV piping comes in both solid core and cellular core construction, each engineered for specific plumbing demands. Solid core PVC consists of uniform plastic throughout the pipe wall, offering superior impact resistance, higher structural rigidity, and better acoustic dampening. Cellular core PVC features a solid outer and inner skin with an expanded plastic foam center, making it lighter and more cost-effective while meeting code for residential DWV. Understanding structural limits, code requirements, and sound transmission helps plumbers select the correct pipe material for exposed, underground, or commercial drainage installations.

Cellular core PVC features a solid outer and inner skin with an expanded plastic foam center, making it lighter and more cost-effective while meeting code for residential DWV. Understanding structural limits, code requirements, and sound transmission helps plumbers select the correct pipe material for exposed, underground, or commercial drainage installations.
